cand.title: SETAC Europe 37th Annual Meeting 2027
cand.organizationName: Society of Environmental Toxicology and Chemistry Europe
cand.excerpt: Strong evidence of a dated organized programme and a plausible airport-corridor lodging/meeting/catering mechanism, discounted where venue/hotel is committed.

quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: Barbara Koelman is the strongest owner-side operational lead: SETAC says she plans the annual meeting, handles future-event bids, logistics and catering, and is the contact for exhibitors, sponsors and partners. Vanessa Unger, Associate Accommodation Coordinator, is the named contact on Congrex’s accommodation-services page; her SETAC 2027 assignment is not established. Jill Murray is Executive Director, SETAC Europe, a senior relationship/escalation contact rather than a verified hotel buyer. None is established as hotel-contract signatory.
findings.futureEdition: Confirmed upcoming: 25–29 April 2027, SETAC Europe 37th Annual Meeting. Official SETAC dates and the French-language Palexpo listing agree. Within the requested horizon. No official 2028 dates, city or venue were located; do not promote third-party approximate 2028 listings to an announced edition.
findings.hotelProductFit: Assessment/inference using supplied hotel constraints: YOTEL Geneva Lake is unsuitable as the primary congress venue or assumed primary housing provider. Its 237 rooms and approximately 250-theatre meeting ceiling support only a small satellite subset of a series with historical multi-thousand attendance. A conditional 20–120-room proposal is a sales-sizing range, NOT published demand. Founex/La Côte location can serve a price-sensitive exhibitor/project group only if Congrex accepts the geography and transport. Official YOTEL information supports airport access, but its morning/evening, first-come airport shuttle is not a dedicated Palexpo group transfer. Any pre/post workshop or hybrid meeting requires an identified organizer and separate demand validation. Banquet/catering capacity remains unverified; do not sell a full-congress dinner or resort retreat.
findings.venueCommitments: Published venue commitment: Centre de Congrès – Palexpo / Palexpo Geneva, Route François-Peyrot 30, 1218 Le Grand-Saconnex, Canton of Geneva, Switzerland. Territory: Geneva Airport corridor, not Founex/La Côte and not downtown Geneva. SETAC states: “The SETAC Europe Annual Meeting will take place at Palexpo”. This establishes the announced venue, not access to its underlying contract. Palexpo is not a competing hotel.
findings.historicalRotation: Verified sequence: 2024 Seville, FIBES II, 5–9 May; 2025 Vienna, Austria Center Vienna, 11–15 May; 2026 Maastricht, MECC Maastricht, 17–21 May; 2027 Geneva, Palexpo, 25–29 April. Consecutive published annual editions establish recurrence, not an annual Geneva return or an open 2028 Swiss bid.
findings.accommodationSourcing: Official edition-specific housing bureau is already appointed. Quote: “Congrex Switzerland Ltd is the official congress partner for hotel accommodation and is the only agency offering accommodation on behalf of SETAC Europe.” The retrieved 2027 Hotels page names no individual hotels, rates, allotments, release dates or room-night totals; therefore no incumbent hotel names can be verified and no open hotel RFP is established. It refers to booking through a link, but the retrieved links did not expose an edition-specific hotel inventory. Congrex describes hotel sourcing, allotment negotiations and HotelMap booking as general services; this is not proof of a particular 2027 hotel block or HotelMap deployment. The bureau appointment is not proof that every delegate must book centrally.
findings.organizationStructure: SETAC Europe is the association owner/organizer, not a scaling company: an incorporated Belgian not-for-profit association (VZW), registration 861.935.367, and a geographic unit of SETAC. Its Executive Director operates under its board. Congrex Switzerland Ltd is the appointed accommodation agency; its broader PCO offering does not establish that it manages the entire 2027 congress. Palexpo is the venue, not the event owner or hotel buyer.
findings.competitiveLimitations: Palexpo is committed and Congrex is the exclusive authorized accommodation agency. Venue-side airport access and published city transport options reduce the case for a more distant Founex stay (inference). No edition-specific competing hotel list, sell-out, waitlist, overflow requirement, unmet room block or Founex lodging pattern was found. Historical attendance is not overflow evidence. Do not imply that YOTEL’s free airport shuttle is a Palexpo shuttle, or that Geneva Transport Card benefits necessarily cover a Vaud hotel.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: First approach Barbara Koelman via barbara.koelman@setac.org / europe-meeting@setac.org to confirm the appointed Congrex account lead and whether a Founex property is acceptable. In parallel, ask Congrex’s published accommodation contact Vanessa Unger via info@congrex.com for that account lead and the route to offer additional inventory. Only if invited, submit a limited 20–120-room option with rates, commission/net terms, cancellation/release schedule and a costed dedicated Palexpo transfer; this is a proposed action, not a request already received. Ask for edition-specific inventory, remaining allotment needs and shuttle requirements before qualifying. Use Jill Murray for senior relationship escalation, not initial hotel-block assumption.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: 2027 is accessible only as a conditional supplier conversation through Congrex/SETAC, not a verified open-sourcing lead. A housing bureau is already appointed, while hotel-level inclusion and additional-allotment acceptance remain unknown. No evidence currently supports bypassing centrally organized housing or independently soliciting delegates. SETAC warns about unauthorized housing approaches; identify the hotel transparently and approach the authorized organizers, not attendees.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Inference: develop a Congrex accommodation-supplier relationship and ask Barbara Koelman about separately sourced smaller SETAC workshops or exhibitor meetings in the Geneva/La Côte corridor. This is a relationship strategy, not an announced programme or a predicted Geneva annual return. Multi-city rotation weakens a recurring annual Founex-room-demand thesis; 2028 remains unannounced in official sources checked.
